kaynak_en: Mars Dust Activity Database v1.1 (Battalio and Wang 2021, Icarus 354, 114059; Battalio et al. 2023), storm masks from MRO MARCI daily global maps, Mars Years 28-32; Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.7480334 (CC BY 4.0)
guven_notu_en: Fraction of observed sols on which a cell was inside a mapped dust storm (storms of roughly 10^5 km2 and larger). Polar-night and unobserved sols excluded. Five Mars years only; global dust events (e.g. MY 28) dominate some years.
